remediation.to_enable_execution_simulated_traces: Install GnuCOBOL: brew install gnucobol (macOS) or apt-get install gnucobol (Linux), then re-run Subagent C
remediation.to_enable_real_execution_traces: Requires z/OS environment with SMF record access
remediation.alternative: Use JCLSimulatorAdapter with a batch-simulation script that invokes GnuCOBOL-compiled COBOL programs
